proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4386 *grilla explicitly gives Punjabi gillā and Hindi gillā wet. The geminate-l forms directly match this family; Turner calls its derivation from *gṛdla very doubtful, a qualification retained here. Exact survey form gilːə is preserved.
